	<description>Returns whether the NPC is facing their ideal yaw. See <page>NPC:SetIdealYaw</page>, <page>NPC:GetIdealYaw</page> and <page>NPC:SetIdealYawAndUpdate</page>.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<added>2023.11.17</added>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether the NPC is facing their ideal yaw.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
